page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top centre; page number top left. Heading "CAP. XIV." centred, then an italic argument summary in a centred block, then body text beginning with a large woodcut initial O. Catchword "addo" at lower right. Digitiser's banner at bottom right is omitted.

main_text.p: minùs principale. Proximum in iftis casibus negligere, directè adverfaretur dilectioni ipsius: sed Sabbathi quietem quodammodò turbare, non sic adverfatur dilectioni ipsius Dei: imò potiùs dilectio Dei hoc exigit, ut tali casû sic proximo succurramus propter ipsum. Nec sublatâ vel imminutâ Sabbathi quiete, prorsus tollitur vel imminuitur necessariò ejus sanctificatio.
main_text.head: CAP. XIV.
Collatio sententiæ Socinianorum de quarto Præcepto. Mutilatio Decalogi. Morale quarti Præcepti. Distinctio Præceptorum. Consensus Theologorum. Conclusio operis.
main_text.p: I. ORthodoxi contra Socinianos nominatim asserere ac defendere solent, quartum Decalogi Præceptum in specie non esse prorsùs Cerimoniale, atque adeò sublatum cum reliquis Cerimoniis; sed esse Morale quoad rem principalem. Sic è pluribus disputantem audivimus Nic. Arnoldum contra Gathechesin Racovianam, lup. Cap. vi. iii. th. 8. Nunc addo

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page is visible in the middle of the page and is omitted. The initial "O" is a large woodcut letter, joined to "Rthodoxi" as "ORthodoxi". The line "lup. Cap. vi. iii. th. 8." is partly obscured and may be misread. The marginal signature mark at lower left, "Σ", is uncertain and omitted.
